crossEpisodeNotes.statement: For order 13 the canonical note points to al-Tabari vol. 18, titled Between Civil Wars and catalogued as 661-680/AH 40-60 (translator Michael G. Morony), while order 13's referenced events are 81-82/700-701. Public catalog search excerpts identify vol. 23, The Zenith of the Marwanid House, as 700-715/AH 81-96 (translator Martin Hinds), a possible bibliographic candidate by date range only. I did not read the Dayr al-Jamajim passage in either volume; vol. 23 is not treated as evidence. The discrepancy is for review, with no canon edit or adjudication.
Canonical date strings, place qualifications, and passage strings are copied verbatim. Similar date ranges across summary sources are reported in their own terms; they are not normalized here.
Political or religious motives remain attributed to the cited synthesis/report. No invented private speech, eyewitness identity, or testimony is added.

decisionStatus: No history, source adequacy, chronology, geography, or campaign approval recorded by collector
